title: Four Poses of Warrior Girl
description: Four side-by-side painted panels show the same young Black girl in an orange futuristic warrior outfit performing a dynamic high-kick pose. Her outfit features intricate armor pieces, belts, and metallic details, with sparks flying from her boots against a dark, smoky background.
prompt: A young Black girl with wild hair in an elaborate orange and black futuristic warrior outfit with armor plates and straps, performing a powerful high kick with sparks flying from her heavy boots. Four separate painted panels arranged horizontally showing the same dynamic pose with slight variations, dramatic lighting, painterly style with visible brushstrokes, dark moody background.
